howto: Tap an empty plot to plant the seed you chose. Swipe across plots to do several at once.
Tap a growing plot to water it: it grows twice as fast. Tap a ripe crop to harvest it.
Fill orders in the Orders tab for coins and XP, or sell crops from the barn.
Level up to unlock crops, then buy plots, a bigger barn and helpers.
tips: Water right after planting to halve the wait.
Slow crops pay much more per plot.
Orders pay 1.5 times the market price.
A full barn blocks harvesting: deliver or sell.
Helpers work while the game is open.

controls.keyboard: Tab to a plot or button and press Enter or Space. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap crops, plots and shop buttons

difficulty: Self-paced: dearer crops take longer but pay more, plot unlocks double in price, and each goal is a bigger coin total.

features.autosave: Crops keep growing by the clock, even when the game is closed
features.goals-or-quests: Delivery-truck orders, daily goals with a streak, 15 deeds
features.day-time-ui: Timers on every plot and a golden-hour scene
features.inventory: A barn with a capacity you can upgrade; sell or deliver crops
features.tutorial: Coach cards: plant, water, harvest, deliver
features.progression: 7 crops unlock from level 1 to 10, 12 plots, barn upgrades, two helpers that work for you
